meanings.note: pertaining to combat or full of fighting spirit

meanings.note: Adds a reason or an obvious truth.

examples.trans: Sit down, don't be afraid. I very nearly let you go myself.

meanings.note: возвращаться домой = to come back home; к + dative = to someone

examples.text: Запомните: зло всегда возвращается к правителю.
examples.trans: Remember: evil always comes back to the ruler.

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.
examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.

зайти.gloss: to come in, to drop in

examples.trans: I'll drop by in the evening.

examples.trans: Well, as you like. Lidia Alekseyevna, come in, please!

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

Look how much blood came out!

meanings.note: Уже месяц = for a month now.

examples.trans: I've been living here for a month.

examples.trans: Pasha and I have been together for a month now.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.trans: The soldiers sat in the trench all night.

meanings.note: платить за + accusative = to pay for

examples.trans: But we can get your job back for you. And we pay well.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Have you completely lost your mind? Why would I need that?

examples.text: Слушай, ты что, совсем сдурел сегодня?
examples.trans: Listen, have you completely lost it today?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Нет, Вика, я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: No, Vika, that's not what I mean at all.

meanings.en: to miss someone (+ по + dat.), to start missing

examples.trans: Do you think I didn't miss you?

examples.text: Ты думаешь, я не соскучился? Я уже на стенку лезу!
examples.trans: Do you think I didn't miss you? I'm already climbing the wall!

examples.trans: Slavik, look here. I'll swap my new iPhone for your old phone.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.
